description.value: Tutto Belle Il Gelato is a gelateria on the popular West 4th Avenue cycling corridor in Kitsilano, blending Canadian seasonal ingredients with authentic Italian gelato-making traditions. The menu spans classic Italian flavors such as pistachio and tiramisu alongside Asian-influenced options including ube, black sesame mochi gelato, and pineapple bun gelato. The shop also produces 'Babylato,' a dog- and toddler-safe frozen treat made with organic Greek yogurt and coconut oil, inspired by the owners' German Shepherd.
